inShort: A lobs over B's head, and B turns, runs back and sends a high lob back. Never backpedal. 10 lobs, then swap.
rules: A and B stand at the kitchen line, straight across.
A calls a side, then lobs over that shoulder of B.
B drops the foot on that side back, turns and runs to the ball. A backpedal restarts the ball.
Take the direct route; don't run around the ball to get a forehand.
At the ball, B sends a lob back, as high as B can.
tooEasy: A no longer calls the side, and B reads it from the ball. Even harder: A varies depth and height, and B counts the controlled replies out of 10.
tooHard: A lobs shorter and slower, always over the same shoulder.
goodLooksLike: B turns sideways on the first step and runs, never walks backwards, and the reply goes very high and deep.
